name: cmdproto
description: Proto-first ABI boundary toolkit for strict human and machine command interfaces.

scripts.schema:build: buf lint proto && mkdir -p dist && buf build proto --as-file-descriptor-set -o dist/schema.binpb && cd tools/buf-plugin-cmdproto && go run ./cmd/runtime-manifest --schema ../../dist/schema.binpb --out ../../dist/runtime.binpb
scripts.schema:build:greeter: buf lint examples/greeter/proto && mkdir -p examples/greeter/dist && buf build examples/greeter/proto --as-file-descriptor-set -o examples/greeter/dist/schema.binpb && cd tools/buf-plugin-cmdproto && go run ./cmd/runtime-manifest --schema ../../examples/greeter/dist/schema.binpb --out ../../examples/greeter/dist/runtime.binpb
scripts.check: buf lint && npm run schema:build && npm run schema:build:greeter && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:plugin
